title: Q-ROOT-unclassified: unclassified keeps recurring: Add a root-cause class (id, match, root, guard, remedy) to doctrine/rootcauses.json for these findings.
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the daily failure audit files it when a root cause recurs; the executor takes it in driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rootcause --probe unclassified
**Status:** open

Root cause class `unclassified` recurred on 8 days (2026-11-21, 2026-11-22, 2026-11-23, 2026-11-24, 2026-11-25, 2026-11-26, 2026-11-27, 2026-11-28); the guard exists and the failure still returned: the guard is ineffective, so redesign it (a fourth attempt of the same fix is not allowed).
Root cause: no root-cause class explains this finding
Guard: `file:doctrine/rootcauses.json`
Remedy: Add a root-cause class (id, match, root, guard, remedy) to doctrine/rootcauses.json for these findings.
Symptoms seen:
- failure-audit:clock-measured: clock-measured a loop's clock has no reading in the published record (no route that can read its beats from this host) c
- failure-audit:content-drift: content-drift a system's feed is unreadable or its newest entries are empty, cut off, templated or repeated ): https://b
- failure-audit:cost-runaway: cost-runaway the cost reading stopped, was unmeasured, or a free-plan limit is near -da5e-41e5-af52-af6c0484a7be", "rows
- failure-audit:d1-growth: d1-growth a database's measured growth reaches the size limit inside the horizon -da5e-41e5-af52-af6c0484a7be", "rowsRea
- failure-audit:discovered-20bcba4f37: discovered-20bcba4f37 unclassified recurring failure 20bcba4f37: 12 open, last seen 2026-11-27T12:41:41+00:00 (quiet mea
- failure-audit:fleet-contract: fleet-contract a system's pages and its endpoints are written in different places, so a sentence stays on a page after i
Fix the root, not the symptom: the item closes when the guard passes and the class stays quiet for 2 days.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rootcause --probe unclassified
